instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: HR tech SaaS platform for mid-market companies offering recruitment pipeline management, onboarding automation, and performance review cycles. 400+ customers, 80,000 active employee profiles. Recently launched an AI-assisted job description generator. Evaluating skills-gap analysis and internal mobility recommendation features. Operate from 2-3 locations or departments. We have some budget headroom for experimentation but look for quick wins that can demonstrate value within 6 months before committing to longer-term programs. The leadership team is aligned on the need to modernize but debates where to start.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have never run a formal innovation initiative. Problems are solved ad-hoc as they arise, usually by the most directly affected team member. There is no dedicated budget, no structured ideation process, and no track record of experimenting with new technologies or business models beyond basic operational necessity.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth. We see untapped demand in adjacent customer segments and are evaluating whether to build, buy, or partner to accelerate market penetration. The core question is whether to deepen our vertical specialization or broaden horizontally into related product categories.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 20% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 2 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Establish a Formalized Innovation Funnel and Prioritization Matrix
opportunities.rationale: The company currently solves problems ad-hoc, hindering scalable growth. Implementing a structured funnel (Ideation -> Validation -> Pilot) will professionalize the innovation process. This is critical to moving beyond reactive fixes and enabling proactive strategic development needed for 30% YoY growth.

first_actions: Develop a lightweight Idea Submission Portal outlining problem, potential solution, and estimated impact/effort (T-shirt sizing).
Mandate bi-weekly 'Opportunity Review' sessions involving the newly hired senior leaders to vet incoming ideas against strategic goals.
Define clear stages: Funnel entry criteria, initial resource allocation gate, and pilot approval process.
resources_needed: Executive time commitment for governance meetings
Cloud service for simple submission platform
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in the number of formally submitted and prioritized project ideas by 50% within six months.
milestones: Pilot program launched with first three high-potential concepts (Month 2)

opportunities.title: Execute a Build/Buy/Partner Assessment for Adjacent Market Deepening
opportunities.rationale: The core strategic dilemma is whether to deepen vertical specialization or broaden horizontally. A structured assessment using market modeling and competitive benchmarking is required to de-risk the decision. This moves beyond simple feature development into true business model expansion.

first_actions: Engage a specialized external consultant (or use existing advisory budget) to map 3 potential adjacent customer segments/market verticals.
Conduct rapid, structured interviews with the top 10 customers to quantify their pain points in those adjacent areas (Voice of Customer).
Develop preliminary ROI models for 'Build,' 'Buy' (acquiring a small competitor), and 'Partner' scenarios for the highest potential market.
resources_needed: Dedicated team bandwidth (2 engineers, 1 business analyst)
execution_plan.success_metric: A prioritized recommendation roadmap detailing the optimal build/buy/partner path with defined resource requirements and target revenue uplift.
milestones: Stakeholder consensus on primary expansion vector (Month 2)
Finalized business case presented to leadership (Month 3)

next_steps.action: Host the first 'Opportunity Review' governance meeting using the new funnel structure to gain initial buy-in and clarity on process.
Draft a clear RACI matrix for the innovation function to formalize decision rights and reduce reliance on single owner sign-off.
Formalize the 16% budget allocation into explicit ring-fenced budgets for 'Innovation Experimentation' and 'Product Expansion Research.'

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated, protected innovation budget and resource allocation.
Decision-making remains bottlenecked at the owner level despite new senior leadership hires.
The organizational process gap persists; relying on ad-hoc problem solving prevents scaling or repeatable success.

improvements: Management structure is improving, moving from founder-led to professionalized leadership.
Company has formalized initial strategic thinking and hired key operational leaders.
Technical capability increased with the successful launch of an AI feature (job description generator).
persistent_gaps: No formal process for ideation vetting or resource allocation exists.
Innovation efforts are still easily derailed by urgent production incidents.
The overarching strategy regarding market focus (depth vs. breadth) remains unresolved.
achieved_milestones: Hiring and integration of two senior leaders has begun to professionalize operations.
Initial capability demonstrated through the AI-assisted job description generator launch.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in organizational structure and technical capability (Digital Maturity 1 -> 2). The company moved from 'none' to actively implementing strategic planning processes and developing core AI features, but the fundamental process and decision-making gaps remain critical.
